units.source_text: 多年之後我才知道，連竹一也沒意識到的這句話，竟然像可怕的惡魔讖言。

en.t: Only many years later did I realize that those words, which even Takeichi himself had not understood, were like a dreadful demonic prophecy.

units.source_text: 什麼「迷戀」還是「被迷戀」，這種話極其低俗和戲弄，給人一種自鳴得意之感，

en.t: Words like being infatuated or being the object of infatuation are terribly vulgar and teasing, and they carry a smug, self-satisfied air,

units.source_text: 不論是在多麼「嚴肅」的場合，這樣的話只要蹦出一句，

en.t: no matter how solemn the occasion may be, if even one such phrase pops out,

units.source_text: 憂鬱的聖殿頃刻間就會土崩瓦解，變得索然無味。

en.t: the melancholy temple collapses in an instant and turns utterly flat and tasteless.

units.source_text: 如果不是用這樣的俗語，而是用文學語言「被愛的不安」來表現，

en.t: if, instead of using such a vulgar phrase, one expressed it in literary language as the anxiety of being loved,

units.source_text: 憂鬱的聖殿也許就會安然無恙，想來真的奇妙無比。

en.t: then the melancholy temple might remain unharmed; when I think about it, it is truly strange.

units.source_text: 我給竹一清理耳朵裡的膿水時，

en.t: When I was cleaning the pus from Takeichi's ear,

units.source_text: 當聽到他奉承我「你這傢伙，肯定會被女孩兒迷戀上的！」

en.t: when I heard him flatter me by saying, You are definitely going to have girls fall for you!
